// about me

Who I Am

I'm a passionate SAP BTP CAPM Developer based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. With over 3 years of experience at SBP Consulting Pvt. Ltd., I specialize in designing and deploying enterprise-grade cloud applications on SAP Business Technology Platform.

My expertise spans the full stack — from CDS-driven backends, multi-tenant SaaS architectures, and SAP HANA analytics, to responsive SAP UI5/Fiori frontends. I've led data migration pipelines handling 200M+ records and integrated PAL-based ML forecasting directly on HANA.

Beyond tech, I'm a cooking enthusiast, dancer, and always exploring emerging cloud technologies. I believe in balancing technical precision with creativity — the same energy that won me two internal hackathons.
